Poonawalla Fincorp Reports Five-Fold Profit Surge in Q2

Poonawalla Fincorp announced a net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, a five-fold increase year-on-year. The company's net interest income rose by 75.6% due to loan portfolio expansion. New disbursements accounted for 28% of the total, exceeding ₹4,400 crore. Revenue for the quarter was reported at ₹2,624 crore.
